text.p: - Merrill Lynch & Co said Tuesday it lowered its earnings forecast for Micron Technology Inc to $1.50 cents a share for fiscal 1997 from a previous forecast of $1.95.
- Merrill Lynch analyst Thomas Kurlak, however, increased his earnings forecast for the fiscal second quarter, ending February, to $0.21 a share from $0.19 cents.
- Kurlak's assistant said the analyst cut his earnings forecast for the year because of lower prices for computer memory chips and higher expenses.
- Kurlak maintains his rating of "accumulate" on the computer memory chip maker, his assistant said.
- Micron Technology shares fell 2-1/2 to 32-1/4 after the company said Monday lower memory chip prices slashed its net income for the fiscal first quarter.
